kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تشاءمت (form VI)
# تَشَاءَمْتُ (tašāʔamtu) /ta.ʃaː.ʔam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
# تَشَاءَمْتَ (tašāʔamta) /ta.ʃaː.ʔam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
# تَشَاءَمْتِ (tašāʔamti) /ta.ʃaː.ʔam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
# تَشَاءَمَتْ (tašāʔamat) /ta.ʃaː.ʔa.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
